document_api_meta.title: Search Creators in Creator Marketplace
document_api_meta.env_desc: This API is used by Sellers to search for Creators in the Creator Marketplace. Sellers can search based on filters such as GMV, keywords, and Creator follower demographics. All the data returned is for the last 30 days.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: Pagination token that identifies where to continue the search. For the first request, omit this parameter or leave it empty. For each subsequent request, pass the next_page_token returned by the previous response.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc: The value of "page_size" must be 12 or 20

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: search_key
request_body_param.desc:
Caching search results improves api performance and ensures stable request results.
You don't need to pass a value on the first call. 
For the second call, please pass the value returned in the response of the first call.

request_body_param.name: keyword
request_body_param.desc: Searching creators by keyword, matching based on TikTok Username and Nickname.

request_body_param.name: follower_demographics
request_body_param.desc: Filtering creators by follower demographics

request_body_param.name: ^age_ranges
request_body_param.desc:
Follower age filtering options, which are range intervals, include: 
AGE_RANGE_18_24: "18-24", 
AGE_RANGE_25_34: "25-34", 
AGE_RANGE_35_44: "35-44", 
AGE_RANGE_45_54: "45-54", 
AGE_RANGE_55_AND_ABOVE: "55+"

request_body_param.name: ^count_range
request_body_param.desc: Follower count filtering

request_body_param.name: ^^count_ge
request_body_param.desc:
The minimum value of follower count. 
The value passed in must be greater than or equal to 0

request_body_param.name: ^^count_le
request_body_param.desc:
The maximum value of follower count. 
- Generally, a value greater than or equal to 0 needs to be passed. If a value less than 0 is passed, it means that the field will not be filtered.

request_body_param.name: ^gender_distribution
request_body_param.desc:
Filters creators by follower gender.
Possible values:
- MALE
- FEMALE

request_body_param.name: ^^gender
request_body_param.desc: A particular gender, "MALE" or "FEMALE"

request_body_param.name: ^^percentage_ge
request_body_param.desc:
Greater than or equal to a certain percentage, scaled up by 10,000 times. 
For example, 6000 stands for 0.6 or 60%

request_body_param.name: gmv_ranges
request_body_param.desc:
Filtering by GMV range intervals which include: 
GMV_RANGE_0_100: "0-100", 
GMV_RANGE_100_1000: "100-1000", 
GMV_RANGE_1000_10000: "1000-10000", 
GMV_RANGE_10000_AND_ABOVE: "10000+"
For example: 
- If GMV_RANGE_0_100 is passed, it means filtering the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.
- If GMV_RANGE_0_100 and GMV_RANGE_100_1000 are passed, it means to filter the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1000.

request_body_param.name: units_sold_ranges
request_body_param.desc:
Filtering by sales volume range intervals which include: 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_0_10: "0-10", 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_10_100: "10-100", 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_100_1000: "100-1000", 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_1000_AND_ABOVE: "1000+"
For example: 
- If UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_0_10 is passed, it means filtering the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 10.
- If UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_0_10 and UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_10_100 are passed, it means to filter the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.

request_body_param.name: category
request_body_param.desc: Array of category filter objects. Use [Get Categories](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-categories-202309) to retrieve category IDs.

request_body_param.name: ^parent_category_id
request_body_param.desc: Category of the parent category. If you are only using a parent category, you do not need to pass in a child category ID.

request_body_param.name: ^child_category_id_list
request_body_param.desc: If you are using the category ID for a child category, you must pass the parent category as well. A child category is only 1 level deeper than the parent category. We do not support going deeper down the category tree (some countries have 4 levels, others have 7)

request_body_param.name: content_performance
request_body_param.desc: Object containing content performance filters

request_body_param.name: ^avg_video_views
request_body_param.desc:
Average Video Views more than
You can pass in average video views anywhere between 0 and 100k
Pick any whole number between 0 and 100,000, and we will return all results with average video views greater than that number.
You can only pass in Average Video Views OR Average Shoppable Video Views. Using both filters will cause the API call to fail.

request_body_param.name: ^avg_shoppable_video_views
request_body_param.desc:
You can pass in average shoppable video views anywhere between 0 and 100k
Pick any whole number between 0 and 100,000, and we will return all results with average shoppable video views greater than that number.
You can only pass in Average Video Views OR Average Shoppable Video Views. Using both filters will cause the API call to fail.

request_body_param.name: ^avg_engagement_rate
request_body_param.desc:
Average engagement rate more than 0-20.
You can only filter by increments of 1% point, up to 20%.

request_body_param.name: ^avg_shopable_engagement_rate
request_body_param.desc:
Average shoppable engagement rate more than 0-20.
You can only filter by increments of 1% point, up to 20%.

request_body_param.name: ^avg_live_avg_viewers_ge
request_body_param.desc:
Filters creators whose average LIVE viewers are greater than or equal to the specified value.
Enter a whole number from 0 to 100,000.
You can only pass one of avg_live_avg_viewers_ge and avg_shoppable_live_avg_viewers_ge. Using both filters causes the API call to fail.

request_body_param.name: ^avg_shoppable_live_avg_viewers_ge
request_body_param.desc:
Filters creators whose average shoppable LIVE viewers are greater than or equal to the specified value.
Enter a whole number from 0 to 100,000.
You can only pass one of avg_live_avg_viewers_ge and avg_shoppable_live_avg_viewers_ge. Using both filters causes the API call to fail.

request_body_param.name: affiliate_data
request_body_param.desc: Object which contains affiliate based data

request_body_param.name: ^avg_commission_rate
request_body_param.desc:
- ALL
- LESS_THAN_20%
- LESS_THAN_15%
- LESS_THAN_10%
- LESS_THAN_5%
Creator's average commission rate range based on showcase products, sales, and promoted products in the last 30 days.
You can only pick one value.

request_body_param.name: ^post_rate
request_body_param.desc:
These categories represent how often a creator posts a shoppable video or LIVE after receiving a sample.
- ALL 
- OK 
- GOOD 
- BETTER
Every country has its own benchmark based on what is a GOOD vs BETTER fulfillment rate. BETTER is always going to have the highest fulfillment rate, including 100% fulfillment rate.

request_body_param.name: ^creator_agency_staus
request_body_param.desc:
- AGENCY_MANAGED
- INDEPENDENT

request_body_param.name: ^is_fast_growing
request_body_param.desc: Top 10% of creators with the greatest increase in transactions, revenue, shoppable videos, live views, or followers in the last 30 days

request_body_param.name: ^not_invited_l90_days
request_body_param.desc:
True/False
Select this filter to see creators you haven't invited in the last 90 days

request_body_param.name: advanced_filters
request_body_param.desc: Advanced filters are specific to each country. Before using advanced filters with this API, use [Get Seller Search Creator Marketplace Advanced Filters](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-seller-search-creator-marketplace-advanced-filters) to retrieve the filters available for the relevant country.

request_body_param.name: ^content_preference_type
request_body_param.desc:
Content preference type. e.g.
-VIDEO
-LIVE

request_body_param.name: ^eligible_flat_fee
request_body_param.desc: Creator is eligible for flat fee invitation, only available in US local seller

request_body_param.name: ^option_list
request_body_param.desc: Creator Marketplace Advanced Filter Option List. Please use "Get Seller Search  Creator Marketplace Advanced Filters"(https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-seller-search-creator-marketplace-advanced-filters) get available options for you first

request_body_param.name: ^sorter_algorithm_id
request_body_param.desc: Sorter algorithm id. Please use "Get Seller Search  Creator Marketplace Advanced Filters"(https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-seller-search-creator-marketplace-advanced-filters) get available sorter algorithm for you first. Default is 1(default sorter)

request_body_param.name: data_groups
request_body_param.desc:
Creator's Data Group, get all group by default, which include: 
- BASIC_CREATOR_INFORMATION
- CONTENT_PERFORMANCE
